# Vendored KasKold compatibility core

These source crates are copied from the user-supplied KasKold 2.0.0 source archive solely to provide exact Ghost Talk interoperability with KasKold wallet import, backup, and PSKT signing formats. Original per-crate licenses are retained; GPL-covered vault/runtime crates are accompanied by the upstream root `LICENSE`.

Ghost Talk uses `kaskold-sdk` for PSKT prepare/complete/finalize and `vault-runtime` for the corresponding KasKold custody/import/backup/signing formats.
